n32bc7b5678.headline: Japan to Invite Taiwan Semiconductor in Building Advanced Chip-Making Plant: Report
n32bc7b5678.summary: Japan is reportedly inviting Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd to participate in building an advanced semiconductor manufacturing plant.
n32bc7b5678.why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker; Japan's move reflects efforts to strengthen domestic semiconductor supply chains amid global chip shortages.

impacts.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd
impacts.why: TSMC's involvement in Japan's chip plant expands its manufacturing footprint.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n32bc7b5678.why_moved: TSMC's potential expansion into Japan signals increased semiconductor production capacity and supply chain diversification, impacting global chip markets and related equities.

ncfd1f4e832.headline: Flight to PSI-20 to the Netherlands has already cost the country thousands of millions of euros, warns José Gusmão
ncfd1f4e832.summary: MEP José Gusmão warns that tax flight to the Netherlands has cost Portugal thousands of millions of euros amid stalled European Council economic crisis response.
ncfd1f4e832.why: Tax avoidance and capital flight impact national tax revenues and economic recovery efforts in the EU.
